history.name: The Bulldog
history.shared_categories: Bars, Beer, Food, Nightlife, Wine & Spirits

text.text_excerpt: This is a good bar. Good bones, good location, good service. It used to cater to a more locals crowd, but they have had some change over in their staff and because of the tour groups that gather outside -- it seems to be way more touristy these days. It might be because of the 2 for 1 pirate drink (some fruity concoction of rum and pink stuff.) I enjoy watching football and grabbing a drink here. The food, while totally bar-fried-frozen, isn't bad and pretty affordable. They have buckets for beer and specials during Saints games. Their bathrooms are some of the cleanest, right off Bourbon. They typically keep all their front doors open, so it's easy to pop in and out and still feel a part...

Actually a big fan of this bar, a nice escape from Bourbon. I would call this a good place to pregame the rest of your night or if you just wanted to take it easy. Service is great, phenomenal- the bartender was super sweet and had a great sense of humor. She was really attentive and made friendly banter with everyone at the bar, not just her regulars. They have a deal with the Haunted History tours place where if you have the sticker from the tour and go in- you'll get two for one hurricanes. Apparently, rumor has it, you can probably walk in here multiple nights in a row and claim you did the tour and still get the same deal...but you did not hear that from me. Totally loved this bar... went here twice on our vacation. Definitely not the biggest place, but its not a tourist trap. The bartenders are super friendly and loved chatting with some locals. Wish we would've tried their Fried Pickles since they are my fave... but it was plenty enough to cool down here and gulp down a couple of drinks.
